senses.gloss: a cylindrical vessel let into the ground of the cellar (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Dolium), in gen. wine- or oil-vessel.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:20">Ab. IV, 20</cite> <he>אל תסתכל בק׳ וכ׳</he> look not at the vessel but at what it contains; <he>יש ק׳ חדש וכ׳</he> many a new vessel is full of old wine (many a young man is a fine scholar) &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:28:1">Koh. R. to VII, 28</cite> <he>ק׳ … מקַנְקַנּוֹ וכ׳</he>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:3">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>נטלו ק׳ אחד וכ׳</he> they took one cask in the cellar &c.; <he>החזירו את הק׳ למקומה</he> (read: <he>למקומו</he>) put the cask back into its place.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:5:4">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כמשלח … וקַנְקַנָּהּ</he> like one sending to his neighbor a cask of wine and the storage vessel with it (making a present of both); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 882">Yalk. Ps. 882</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:1:2">Y. Bets. IV, beg. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>מביאה על גב קנקנה</he> he brings the load of wine in its original vessel (not bottle-wise); a. fr.—Pl. <he>קַנְקַנִּים</he>, <he>קַנְקַנִּין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:3">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>היוצר … בודק ק׳ מרועעים וכ׳</he> the potter does not try (knock at) the defective vessels …, but he tries the sound (so God tries not the bad but the good men).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:4">Keth. XIII, 4</cite> <he>והודה בק׳</he> but admits that he owes the (empty) vessels, v. <cite ref="K00099"><he>כַּד</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 108b:14">Ib. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>יש בלשון הזה לשון ק׳</he> the expression ‘vessels of oil’ includes vessels, i.e. one who claims vessels of oil claims not only a certain quantity of oil, but also the vessels.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:28:1">Koh. R. to VII, 28</cite> <he>צפה הקב״ה בכל הק׳ ולא מצא וכ׳</he> the Lord looked at all vessels (fit to receive the Law), and found none better pitched than that of Moses &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:4">B. Mets. VI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 80a">80ᵃ</cite>).—[<cite ref="Eruvin 101a:2">Erub. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ הנגרר</he> a plough used as a bar, Rashi; v. next w.]
